"""Public-interface regression tests. No reference executable is needed."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr.decode())
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b'')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, expected.encode())

    def test_version(self):
        self.assert_sql('', 'v0.0.1 (Unknown Version) 780a73962f\n', ('--version',))

    def test_help(self):
        result = self.run_sql('', ('--help',))
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn(b'FILENAME', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn(b'-jsonlines', result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b'')

        self.assert_sql('select 42 as answer;',

    def test_decimal_and_boolean(self):
        self.assert_sql("select 0.1+0.2 as d, true as b, null as n;", 'd,b,n\n0.3,true,NULL\n')

    def test_json(self):
        self.assert_sql("select 1 as n, true as b, null as x, 'hi' as s;",
                        '[{"n":1,"b":"true","x":null,"s":"hi"}]\n', ('-json',))

    def test_dot_csv_newlines(self):
        self.assert_sql('.mode csv\nselect 1 as n;\n', 'n\r\n1\r\n', ())

    def test_separator_and_headers(self):
        self.assert_sql('select 1 as a, 2 as b;', '1;2!',
                        ('-list', '-noheader', '-separator', ';', '-newline', '!'))

    def test_range_aggregates(self):
        self.assert_sql('select count(*) n,sum(i) s,avg(i) a from range(5)t(i);',
                        'n,s,a\n5,10,2.0\n')

    def test_large_range(self):
        self.assert_sql('select count(*) n,sum(i) s from range(1000000000)t(i);',
                        'n,s\n1000000000,499999999500000000\n')

    def test_grouping(self):
        self.assert_sql('select i%2 g,count(*) n,sum(i) s from range(6)t(i) group by all order by g;',
                        'g,n,s\n0,3,6\n1,3,9\n')

    def test_join(self):
        self.assert_sql("select a.id,b.v from (values(1),(2))a(id) left join (values(2,'x'))b(id,v) using(id) order by id;",
                        'id,v\n1,NULL\n2,x\n')

    def test_cte(self):
        self.assert_sql('with recursive t(i) as(select 1 union all select i+1 from t where i<4) select * from t;',
                        'i\n1\n2\n3\n4\n')

    def test_window(self):
        self.assert_sql('select i,sum(i) over(order by i) s,lag(i) over(order by i) p from range(4)t(i) order by i;',
                        'i,s,p\n0,0,NULL\n1,1,0\n2,3,1\n3,6,2\n')

    def test_lists(self):
        self.assert_sql('select list_transform([1,2,3], lambda x: x*2) l,[1,2,3][2] x;',
                        'l,x\n"[2, 4, 6]",2\n')

    def test_pivot(self):
        self.assert_sql("pivot (values('a','x',1),('a','y',2),('b','x',3))t(g,k,v) on k using sum(v) group by g order by g;",
                        'g,x,y\na,1,2\nb,3,NULL\n')

    def test_transactions(self):
        self.assert_sql('create table t(i int); begin; insert into t values(1); rollback; select count(*) n from t;',
                        'n\n0\n')

    def test_mutation(self):
        self.assert_sql("create table t(i int,s varchar);insert into t values(1,'a'),(2,'b');update t set i=i*10;delete from t where i=10;select * from t;",
                        'i,s\n20,b\n')

    def test_dates(self):
        self.assert_sql("select date '2024-02-28'+interval '2 days' as d,year(date '2024-01-01') as y;",
                        'd,y\n2024-03-01 00:00:00,2024\n')

    def test_script_and_csv(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            Path(tmp, 'data.csv').write_text('id,name\n1,Alice\n2,Bob\n')
            result = self.run_sql("select * from 'data.csv' order by id;", ('-csv',), tmp)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout, b'id,name\n1,Alice\n2,Bob\n')

    def test_persistence(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            db = str(Path(tmp, 'test.db'))
            first = self.run_sql('', (db, 'create table t(i int); insert into t values(7);'))
            self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
            second = self.run_sql('', ('-csv', db, 'select * from t;'))
            self.assertEqual(second.stdout, b'i\n7\n')

    def test_error_and_bail(self):
        result = self.run_sql('select bad;\nselect 2;\n', ('-bail',))
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, b'')
        self.assertIn(b'Binder Error: Referenced column "bad"', result.stderr)
        self.assertIn(b'LINE 1: select bad;', result.stderr)

    def test_overflow(self):
        result = self.run_sql('select 2147483647+1;')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr,
                         b'Out of Range Error: Overflow in addition of INT32 (2147483647 + 1)!\n')

    def test_unavailable_extension(self):
        result = self.run_sql("select json('{\"a\":1}');")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn(b'exists in the json extension', result.stderr)

    def test_readonly_memory(self):
        result = self.run_sql('', ('-readonly', ':memory:', 'select 1;'))
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b'Catalog Error: Cannot launch in-memory database in read-only mode!\n')

    def test_exit_status(self):
        result = self.run_sql('.exit 7\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 7)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

    def test_transactions(self):
        self.assert_sql('create table t(i int); begin; insert into t values(1); rollback; select count(*) n from t;',
                        'n\n0\n')

    def test_mutation(self):
        self.assert_sql("create table t(i int,s varchar);insert into t values(1,'a'),(2,'b');update t set i=i*10;delete from t where i=10;select * from t;",
                        'i,s\n20,b\n')

    def test_dates(self):
        self.assert_sql("select date '2024-02-28'+interval '2 days' as d,year(date '2024-01-01') as y;",
                        'd,y\n2024-03-01 00:00:00,2024\n')

    def test_script_and_csv(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            Path(tmp, 'data.csv').write_text('id,name\n1,Alice\n2,Bob\n')
            result = self.run_sql("select * from 'data.csv' order by id;", ('-csv',), tmp)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout, b'id,name\n1,Alice\n2,Bob\n')

    def test_persistence(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            db = str(Path(tmp, 'test.db'))
            first = self.run_sql('', (db, 'create table t(i int); insert into t values(7);'))
            self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
            second = self.run_sql('', ('-csv', db, 'select * from t;'))
            self.assertEqual(second.stdout, b'i\n7\n')

    def test_error_and_bail(self):
        result = self.run_sql('select bad;\nselect 2;\n', ('-bail',))
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, b'')
        self.assertIn(b'Binder Error: Referenced column "bad"', result.stderr)
        self.assertIn(b'LINE 1: select bad;', result.stderr)

    def test_overflow(self):
        result = self.run_sql('select 2147483647+1;')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr,
                         b'Out of Range Error: Overflow in addition of INT32 (2147483647 + 1)!\n')

    def test_unavailable_extension(self):
        result = self.run_sql("select json('{\"a\":1}');")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn(b'exists in the json extension', result.stderr)

    def test_readonly_memory(self):
        result = self.run_sql('', ('-readonly', ':memory:', 'select 1;'))
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b'Catalog Error: Cannot launch in-memory database in read-only mode!\n')

    def test_exit_status(self):
        result = self.run_sql('.exit 7\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 7)
